# First Deploy

> First Deploy is an after-hours phone desk and live apps for field-service businesses, built by AgentHive Inc in Palm Coast, Florida. Setup is $1,750: start with 50% ($875) and pay the balance at completion, or pay in full. The desk is $250/month, starting at go-live (invoiced separately). One leak goes live this week on a written plan.

## Business
- Name: First Deploy, a product of AgentHive Inc (AGENTHIVEINCCOM LLC)
- Location: Palm Coast, FL (Flagler County), United States
- Service area: Florida statewide, focused on Flagler, Volusia, St. Johns, Duval and Orange counties and the Jacksonville, Daytona Beach and Orlando metros. Setup is done remotely, so businesses anywhere in the US can use it.
- Trades served: HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, pest control, landscaping (also auto and truck repair shops)

## Services
- After-hours desk: a voice line that answers calls after hours, books the job and sends the follow-up.
- Live apps: the working tools the crew opens, such as estimates, booking and follow-up texts, and job records.
- Consult: a free 30-minute qualifier, then paid operator time.

## Pricing
- Setup: $1,750 one-time. Start with 50% ($875 deposit) and pay the balance at completion, or pay in full at $1,750.
- Desk: $250/month per company, starting at go-live (invoiced separately). Cancel any time.
- Consult: free 30-minute qualifier, then $75 / 30 min, $150 / hour, or a 10-hour pack at $1,250 ($625 up front).
- Checkout is by Stripe.
